usage: policy for pushes/pull requests without the specified number of reviewers
name: All code changes should be reviewed
description: Pushed code should be reviewed by a minimum number of users as defined in the policy.
detailedDescription: Reviews are one of the best ways to reduce the risk of security vulnerabilities making it to production. When researchers tried to intentionally insert malicious code in to the Linux Kernel, two man reviews caught the majority of issues.

args.name: reviews
args.label: Reviews Required
args.tooltip: Please specify the minimum number of reviewers per code push for the policy.

args.name: files
args.label: Files Changed
args.tooltip: Please specify the minimum number of files changed for the policy.

args.name: minConsideration
args.label: Ignore Older Code Changes (Months)
args.tooltip: Please specify the max number of months to find changes to evaluate

args.name: alwaysIgnoreFileTypes
args.label: Ignore File Types
args.tooltip: Choose the file types that will not trigger a violation

args.name: minBP
args.label: Ignore Business Priority Less Than
args.tooltip: Ignore repos with Business Priority less than the number entered

args.name: ignoreAdminOwners
args.label: Ignore Admins & Owners
args.tooltip: An admin will not trigger a violation

args.name: dominantPercentage
args.label: Dominant Language Percentage Min
args.tooltip: A violation will not occur if dominant language percentage is lower than value
